subject.title: fix(mcp): allow token auth profiles for bearer projection

question: Should MCP bearer projection intentionally accept generic `type: "token"` auth profiles in addition to OAuth profiles, rather than keeping bearer projection OAuth-only?
rationale: This changes the credential-routing contract for a configuration field named `oauth.authProfileId`; tests can verify mechanics but cannot decide the permanent product and secret-scope policy.

options.title: Accept token-profile projection
options.body: Approve token profiles as supported bearer credentials for explicitly configured MCP servers, contingent on redacted real behavior proof and preserved fail-closed rejection for unsupported types.

options.title: Keep OAuth-only semantics
options.body: Retain the existing OAuth-only contract and use a separate, explicitly named MCP bearer-token configuration or profile mechanism if this workflow is needed.

recommendation.title: Accept token-profile projection
recommendation.body: Approve token profiles as supported bearer credentials for explicitly configured MCP servers, contingent on redacted real behavior proof and preserved fail-closed rejection for unsupported types.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the concrete MCP auth-profile proposal and its stated LifeOS use case; ownership confidence is low because current-main feature history could not be established from the supplied review material.
